cards.title: Parenting the Emotionally Intense Child
cards.body: Children express emotions in dramatically different ways, and understanding these differences is key to helping them thrive. Learn strategies to support emotionally intense kids and help them develop healthy emotional regulation.

cards.title: Co-Regulation: Rhythm Helps Kids and Adults
cards.body: From lullabies to work songs, rhythm helps humans co-regulate at home and work throughout life. Understanding this principle can strengthen parent-child bonding and emotional development.

cards.title: The Difficulty of Twin Estrangement
cards.body: Raising twins requires intentional focus on individual development to prevent estrangement later in life. Without adequate attention to each child's unique identity, twin relationships can suffer significantly.

cards.title: The Unexpected Legacy of Childhood Adversity
cards.body: Every child experiences hardship differently and responds uniquely to difficult conditions. Understanding these individual differences helps parents support children through challenges more effectively.

cards.title: Teaching Kids Employability Skills Early
cards.body: Year 10 pupils are learning workplace skills like handshakes and eye contact to reduce youth unemployment. Early exposure to these soft skills can significantly improve job prospects later in life.
